label: The format system is a two-party binary restated at four definition sites with no third tier for a many-change concise entry, so a 10+ change release is routed to Expanded before any content decision is made
The format selection guide mandates Expanded for 10+ changes and for any breaking change regardless of count, which is exactly the case the short v4.0.1.0 entry represents

Expanded format has no file-total ceiling and every ceiling in the length table is calibrated against the 535-line exemplar, so the long form is legal by construction and no writer has a length target to hit

The exemplar-wins clause grants a 535-line file authority over shape while the length hedge sits inside the same sentence, and SKILL.md converts it into the unfalsifiable test that an entry must sit beside the exemplar without looking out of place

Each H4 item is allowed up to seven paragraphs against a stated norm of one or two, and a 22-item entry at the permitted maximum runs past the exemplar itself, so the ceiling is a drafting affordance the short format never uses

Upgrade Notes are typed by action through fixed Adopt, Repoint and Drop lead-ins and no rule anywhere gives them a section ordering, so an upgrade block ordered by section is off-contract and the action-typed block is the only shape the packet teaches

Small fixes have no container: the sole instruction to fold them into one sentence or leave them out sits under the Drop-by-Default heading, so both permitted outcomes are prose-level and a generator obeying the packet never builds the grouped bullet list the short entry uses
Topical-domain guidance caps the count at one to five but re-opens it by reference to the exemplar's size, so the escape hatch is again sized against the long artifact
Selection opens with an exhaustive-enumeration instruction and validation adds no upper bound on topical items, so a five-item and a forty-item entry both pass the same checks

The spec-folder line is mandated with a (Level {N}) suffix on the one line the Drop list exempts from the internal-label ban, and no rule or check governs whether the suffix is required, optional or exemplary

The packet's only remedy for a long entry is prose-level editing through template section 3, and no later workflow step can re-select the format, so the failure mode is self-reinforcing rather than merely unpunished

ROUTER.md and references/README.md add no format constraint and load the whole flat inventory on any global match, and their precedence rule is inverted by the template's exemplar-wins clause, so both precedence orders are live in one load

No worked model exists at the scale the short format occupies: the compact example is two bullets and the expanded excerpt is gated to 10+ changes, so the only available model for a many-change release is the 535-line exemplar

The success criteria bind correctness to the two tiers and reduce audience fit to the unmeasured phrase only what the reader needs, which none of the ten validation checks operationalize, so a third format would fail the criteria as written

The long-format push is concentrated in the template file and mirrored in SKILL.md sections 5, 7, 9 and 12, worked-examples.md and the packet README, while version-bump-rules.md and topology-edge-cases.md are clean and version-bump-rules.md supplies the missing corrective pattern by separating major from large the way a format rule must separate large from long

Any edit that fixes the long-format default must change assets/changelog-template.md, because SKILL.md, the packet README and worked-examples.md all delegate format authority to it and an edit confined to SKILL.md would leave the tier model self-contradicting

A conciseness rule is unfalsifiable unless it is paired with a total-length ceiling for the selected format, because every existing ceiling is set at or above the exemplar and therefore admits the long form

The packet currently contains two live precedence chains, references/README.md granting SKILL.md and the template precedence and the template granting the exemplar precedence over itself, so no single top of the chain exists today
